title: Building a StoryBrand
author: Donald Miller
whyInteresting: Clarifies how to communicate a brand message so customers actually listen, using a proven storytelling framework.
keyPromise: Learn to cut through the noise and connect with customers by making them the hero of your story.

title: Managing Oneself
author: Peter F. Drucker
whyInteresting: A concise guide to understanding your own strengths, values, and how you work best — essential for anyone trying to perform at their peak.
keyPromise: Discover how to place yourself where you can make the greatest contribution.

title: Pre-Suasion
author: Robert Cialdini
whyInteresting: Explores how to prepare your audience before delivering your message, so they are already primed to agree.
keyPromise: Master the art of channeling attention to make your message land before you even say it.

title: The Art of Thinking Clearly
author: Rolf Dobelli
whyInteresting: A catalogue of 99 cognitive biases and logical errors we make daily, with clear explanations to help avoid them.
keyPromise: Become aware of your mental blind spots and make significantly better decisions.

title: Yes!
author: Noah J. Goldstein, Steve J. Martin, Robert B. Cialdini
whyInteresting: 50 science-backed techniques for persuasion and influence, presented in short, actionable chapters.
keyPromise: Small, evidence-based changes to how you ask can dramatically increase compliance and cooperation.
